label: boot_bundle
_comment: docs/DEVICE_TASKS.md S2b.1's 'add a token vector'. Kept in its own file rather than appended to tools/authvectors.json: that file's consumer, relay/tests/test_devauth.py (outside this task's Files list), asserts the vector list's label *set* equals an exact 8-item set and parametrizes every entry over devauth's own (key_b64/topic/obj/json_signed_b64/cbor_signed_b64) shape -- appending a differently-shaped setup-code vector there would break test_devauth.py without touching it, which the task's ground rules forbid. See relay/tests/test_devsetup.py, which reads this file instead.

label: boot_bundle_ca_pointer
_comment: docs/V02_DESIGN.md section 4.4 (task: relay/protocol half of section 4): a second vector, ADDED alongside the original 'boot_bundle' entry rather than replacing it, for the pointer bundle shape (ca_url/ca_sha, boot keys 40/41) -- the original vector keeps pinning the v0.1-era inline `ca` (boot key 34), which firmware must keep accepting. See tools/setup_code_vectors.json's first entry's own _comment for why this lives in this file rather than tools/authvectors.json.
